name: Chocolate-chip banana protein pancake bowls — optimized (whole spelt, berries)

source.author: Optimized version of choc_chip_banana_protein_pancake_bowls
source.notes: Optimized version of choc_chip_banana_protein_pancake_bowls, adopted per user request (original stays as reference). Changes: all-purpose flour → whole-spelt flour (same amount), chocolate chips halved to 2 tbsp (scattered on top only), half the banana swapped for ~75 g mixed berries. Same casein, eggs, almond milk, Greek yogurt, sugar-free syrup, bake. 2 bowls. Estimate.

ingredients.note: replaces the other half of the banana

steps: Preheat to 350°F (175°C) and grease two oven-safe dishes.
Whisk the eggs, almond milk, yogurt, vanilla and sugar-free syrup.
Add the whole-spelt flour, protein powder and baking powder; mix until just combined.
Fold in the banana and berries.
Divide between the dishes, scatter the chocolate chips on top, and bake 20–25 min until golden and cooked through. Cool slightly.

batch_totals.note: Both bowls, optimized. Vs the original (per bowl ~537 kcal / 41.9 g protein / 65 g carb / 3.9 g fibre): ~68 kcal less, ~12.6 g fewer carbs, nearly double the fibre, same protein — ~9.1 g protein per 100 kcal.

him.verdict: Same ~42.5 g protein per bowl, now for ~469 kcal (~9.1 g protein per 100 kcal, up from 7.8) with ~6.9 g fibre instead of ~3.9. Whole spelt, half the chocolate and berries in place of half the banana trim the sugar-heavy carbs while keeping it a genuinely dessert-like breakfast.
flags: ~42.5 g protein / ~469 kcal per bowl (~9.1 g/100 kcal)

her_preconception.verdict: Good for her: fully baked eggs, pasteurized yogurt, protein + calcium + choline, and now berries for vitamin C and fibre. Use a reputable, third-party-tested casein in pregnancy.

safety_advisories.note: Use a reputable, third-party-tested protein powder in pregnancy.
safety_advisories.swap: a tested casein, or more Greek yogurt + an extra egg

suggested_mods: Add berries for vitamin C and fibre

cooking_guide: Whisk all the wet ingredients smooth first, then add the dry — casein clumps easily if it hits liquid unevenly.
Mix only until no dry streaks remain; overmixing makes protein bakes rubbery.
Casein batters are thick — that's normal; don't thin it out, it bakes up fluffy.
Dice the banana small so it's evenly spread and doesn't make wet pockets.
Check at 20 minutes: a toothpick in the centre should come out clean (melted chocolate aside). Overbaking dries protein-powder bakes fast.
Let them rest a few minutes — they finish setting as they cool.
adopted_note: Adopted 2026-11-18 (optimized). Per bowl (of 2): ~469 kcal, 42.5 g protein, 52.5 g carb, 10.2 g fat, 6.9 g fibre. him 8 / her 7. Standing spec: whole-spelt flour, 2 tbsp chocolate chips on top only, ½ banana + ~75 g berries, casein + 0% Greek yogurt + 2 eggs, bake 350°F 20–25 min.
